displayAddress: Hamilton Street, Landore, Swansea, West Glamorgan, SA1 2QJ
description:
Offering immense potential for first-time buyers eager to infuse their personal style or for investors seeking a valuable addition to their portfolio. This home is available with early completion and no onward chain, facilitating a straightforward acquisition for those ready to embark on a significant refurbishment journey.
Situated in a highly convenient location, this home provides excellent access to local amenities. Morfa Retail Park is within easy reach for shopping needs, and the Liberty Stadium is nearby for sports enthusiasts. Swansea City Centre, with its diverse array of shops, restaurants, and entertainment options, is also just a short distance away, offering a vibrant urban lifestyle. This position combines the benefits of residential living with unparalleled access to essential services and leisure activities.
The lounge/diner offers a functional layout and the space provides a foundation for creating a comfortable living and dining area tailored to contemporary tastes. Adjacent to this is the fitted kitchen, offering a light and airy feel with plenty of natural light. 
Upstairs, the two double bedrooms offer generous proportions. These rooms provide a solid base for creating comfortable sleeping quarters once updated. The family bathroom features a four-piece suite, including a walk-in shower and a separate bath. 
Externally, the enclosed tiered rear garden offers an outdoor space that, with attention and landscaping, could become a pleasant area for relaxation.
